family_checks.result: 1 finding (CLM-0031). Tested incident_date against first_incepted and cover_end for all 99. CLM-0045 incident 11 Sep precedes the current period start (14 Sep) but is after first_incepted (2021), so it is the legitimate earlier-period-of-a-renewal case. Four claims on Cancelled policies (0015, 0022, 0041, 0064) are inside cover dates; no cancellation date is held, so not flagged.

1 finding (CLM-0007). Ran the calculator on every claim with a proposed settlement and agreed items; all others match. No valuables above the single article limit without a specified item; trace and access caps not breached.

2 findings (CLM-0034, CLM-0047). Excess controls run. CLM-0066 (£360.50 + £139.50 across two supplier payments) is the legitimate case of excess taken once from the first payments. CLM-0078 deducts £100 per section on a buildings and contents claim, allowed by H-1.2. CLM-0042 is non-fault but not yet recovered, so no refund is due. Recorded excess matches policy type on all claims.

1 finding (CLM-0057). Every theft and malicious damage claim checked for a crime reference; items over £500 checked for proof. CLM-0067 lacks proof but has no proposed settlement or payment. Small supplier payments on Partial-evidence storm claims (0084, 0087, 0089, 0092, 0096, 0098) have no settlement proposed and are treated as make-safe or interim payments, not settlements.

1 finding (CLM-0038 with CLM-0033). Reviewed all 20 screened pairs from the invoices control. The other pairs involve different equipment, amounts and policies with overlapping dates, which is the legitimate distinct-work counterpart.

1 finding (CLM-0020). CLM-0027 (H-2.3 fence), CLM-0054 (H-5.1, seepage shown by plumber's report) and CLM-0059 (M-4.1, engine running and keys in car per police report) are supported by the clause and evidence. All four declines were approved by a Team Leader (STF-03).
No findings. Every approver's settlement authority covers the proposed settlement on all 99 claims; CLM-0007 (£29,780) is approved by a Claims Manager.

No standalone finding. All 10 complaints checked: the summary resolution and final responses were within time, redress was paid within 10 working days, and CMP-007 and CMP-010 are open and within limits. CMP-001 is covered under the CLM-0020 finding because its Not upheld outcome rests on the contradicted decline.

findings.summary: Proposed settlement £29,780 exceeds the £25,000 contents sum insured (agreed items £29,880). Calculator: cap at £25,000 less £100 excess = £24,900. £5,000 interim already paid; balance not yet paid. Specified-item counterpart does not apply: no valuables.

Incident 2026-09-05 is before the policy was first taken out (first_incepted and cover_start 2026-09-08). Not a renewal, so the earlier-period counterpart does not apply. Settlement of £4,120 agreed on the basis 'Cover confirmed as Active', which does not show period of cover.

Non-fault collision: third-party insurer paid £2,578.34 on 2026-10-15, equal to the amount we paid the repairer, so recovery is in full. The £500 excess has not been refunded. Other recovered non-fault claims (0004, 0024, 0025) were refunded.

Single-section escape of water claim with £350 excess recorded, but £350 deducted from each of two payments (£700). Policyholder received £4,040 net against the correct £4,390 (calculator); underpaid £350. Not a two-section claim, so the second-excess counterpart does not apply.

Theft settled and paid £4,048 with evidence_status Insufficient: no crime reference, and no proof of ownership or value for laptop (£1,849), phone (£1,099) or gold chain (£1,200), all over £500. Note says it was settled to meet the 10-day target. Alternative proof types (statement, photo, packaging) also absent.

Declined under H-5.1 (wear and tear) but the description and the plumber's report (relied on in complaint CMP-001) say the kitchen tap hose burst suddenly, an insured escape of water under H-2.2. Evidence contradicts the clause, so R-06 says accept. CMP-001 was closed Not upheld on the same reasoning.

SUP-17 drying invoice DRN-08562/2 on CLM-0038 duplicates DRN-08562 on CLM-0033: same amount £2,184.00, same dates 12-18 Sep, same equipment and description, on different policies. Both paid (2026-10-07 and 2026-10-12). Not distinct work on different properties.
